role_in_parent: Provide the candidate maximum value and show that the last interval really attains it.
statement_nl: For every real x with (n-1)/n <= x < 1, F_n(x) = H_n - 1.

domain_restrictions: x satisfies (n minus 1) divided by n <= x
the expression (n minus 1) divided by n is defined, so n is not 0
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: Fix an index n for which (n minus 1) divided by n is defined. Then for all real x with (n minus 1) divided by n <= x and x < 1, the value of F_n at x equals H_n minus 1.
quantifier_order: for all real x, under the stated condition on x

variables.name: n
variables.role: indexes the families F_n and H_n; also appears in the lower bound (n minus 1) divided by n
variables.type: integer (parameter, not quantified in the statement as written)

variables.name: x
variables.role: input variable to the function F_n

variables.domain: domain includes at least the real numbers used for x
variables.name: F_n
variables.role: indexed by n; maps x to a value that is asserted to equal H_n minus 1 on a specified interval

variables.domain: not specified; must be defined for the given n and allow subtraction by 1
variables.name: H_n
variables.role: indexed by n; appears as a constant target value for F_n(x) on the interval
variables.type: value (real number or otherwise compatible with F_n(x))

witness_dependencies: none (no existential quantifiers; no witnesses are introduced)
